label: Alafasy 6:145 real إِلَّا re-say behind an unspoken word 13 lead
notes: Replaces the ear-less one_utterance [12,13] correction that collapsed a genuine re-say. The audio-proven unspoken lead is word 13 at 14650-15390 (XLSR/MMS label probability 0.0/0.0003; waveform silent), so its interval returns to word 12 and the later real word 13 at 17590 stays. The maintainer's Lab capture confirms word 12 is said twice; it painted the re-say at 15957-16557, but the decoded waveform shows one held vowel from 15460 to ~17560 at constant 216 Hz while XLSR/MMS force the second occurrence to 15446-16066/15506-16006 and decode no speech in between, so the reviewed boundaries use the source's own tiling and the Lab window is recorded as an ear-only estimate that sits inside the voiced span. quran-align independently gives word 12 one span to 17580 and word 13 from 17590.
